tagline: A low, open mattress with no high walls, in an understated geometric grey.
lead: Your dog gets an open place to lie on their favourite floor spot, with no high walls in the way.
value: One clear 100 × 70cm footprint and a cover that unzips for a 30°C machine wash: simple to live with every day.
intro: Heather is a low-profile dog mattress, 100 × 70cm, with a geometric grey cover that unzips for a 30°C machine wash. An uncomplicated shape for beside the desk, the chair or the sofa.
points: The low profile avoids high surrounding walls, for dogs who like to lie out in the open.
A geometric grey cover adds interest without a loud colour.
The cover unzips and goes in the machine.
best_for: Dogs who prefer a low, open mattress over high-sided bedding, beside a desk, a chair or the family sofa.
fit_note: One size, so check it against their stretched-out length: measure your dog lying down, nose to base of tail, and add 15–20cm. Unsure? Ask us.
care: Wash the removable cover at 30°C, following the sewn-in label. Air-dry fully before refitting. Do not wash or soak the foam.

seo_description: A low, open dog mattress for dogs who prefer no high sides. Understated geometric grey cover that unzips for a 30°C wash. One size, 100 × 70cm.
